Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

670-1430-1619-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirror Image and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1809-1987-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1809-1987-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

851-5660-6441-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

876-3043-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Axebane Guardian.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Axebane Guardian.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Axebane Guardian.
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Axebane Guardian.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Axebane Guardian.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Axebane Guardian from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.

The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1418-1651-3875-4935-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-3875-4935-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-3875-4935-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1414-1456-4195-4574.description:

Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lotus Petal from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

997-2014-3055.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Yosei.
When Yosei dies, it and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing the next player in turn order to skip their next untap step.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
At the beginning of the end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Yosei.
Repeat during each turn unless you are the next player in turn order.

751-3821-6751.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can produce at least {2}{U}.
751-3821-6751.description:
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Panharmonicon.
Resolve one Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {2}{U}.
Resolve the remaining Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {2}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Panharmonicon, returning itself and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 4, this combo produces infinite mana.

4598-6333--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Essence Flux from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the extra turn spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.
4598-6333--88.notes: You must use an extra turn spell that will be put into your graveyard as it resolves, not exile or shuffling into your library.

When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Repeat.

If Flame Jab is in your graveyard, cast it for its retrace cost by paying {1} and discarding a basic land card, targeting Polyraptor.
Otherwise, cast it by paying {1}, targeting Polyraptor.
Resolve Flame Jab, dealing 1 damage to Polyraptor.

If you cast Flame Jab from your graveyard, activate Groundskeeper by paying {2}, returning a basic land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other target using Flame Jab.
